bureau: Mala'a (Oman Credit and Financial Information Centre)
note: Bank Dhofar's guide to Mala'a: an individual's credit report covers credit contracts over the previous 24 months, written as two years. The Central Bank of Oman's Mala'a page (read after completing its certificate chain from DigiCert's AIA copy) states no period, so the bank's guide is registered as secondary. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update. Re-read 2026-11-03: Mala'a's own site (the centre the Central Bank of Oman set up) states the personal report covers credit facilities over the past 24 months, and its customer guide the 24 months of payment history, as Bank Dhofar's guide said; neither states a legal ceiling. The fact is found on Mala'a's own pages and the bank's guide is no longer cited.

sources.title: Mala'a (Oman Credit and Financial Information Centre, malaa.gov.om, the site the Central Bank of Oman's Mala'a page links to), Products and services: Individuals and Corporates, Mala'a Credit Report (read after completing the server's certificate chain with DigiCert's intermediate; verification on)
sources.said: Mala’a Credit Report The Mala’a Personal Credit Report offers a complete overview of an individual’s credit history, helping them monitor their financial health and enhance their credit profile. It includes Credit Accounts Overview Comprehensive details of loans, credit cards, and other credit facilities held over the past 24 months. ... Financial Insights Records of missed payments, overdue accounts, and bounced checks.
